x-changelog.summary: Sheet number support for v1 drawings update APIs
x-changelog.description: Drawings update APIs now accept optional `sheet_number` in update payloads when sheet-number support is enabled, allowing number updates to be disambiguated in multi-sheet workflows. Clients may also send `sheet_number: null` to clear an existing value. Update handling preserves canonical drawing numbers by stripping an echoed `(<sheet_number>)` suffix from `number` inputs before persistence. Enablement is managed internally by the Drawings development team. Please contact your Procore Account Manager or Support to request enablement. When not enabled, endpoints keep current behavior aside from allowing a clear.

x-changelog.summary: Update permits reuse of deleted drawing number
x-changelog.description:
Previously, the error `drawing number already in use` prevented user from updating a drawing with a deleted drawing number.
This change allows the drawing to be updated with that deleted drawing number.

x-changelog.description: Add optional id sort direction to sort revisions based on their ID in ascending or descending order.

x-changelog.summary: Populated custom field values in the web index drawing revisions response
x-changelog.description:
The list drawing revisions endpoint now includes fully resolved `custom_fields` data
(`data_type` and `value`) in the `view=web_index` response payload, instead of an
empty object. This is additive and does not change any existing fields.

x-changelog.summary: Sheet number support for drawing revisions APIs
x-changelog.description: Drawing revisions payloads now include `sheet_number` and canonical `drawing_number` alongside display-formatted `number` for sheet-aware identification. For multi-sheet records, clients should treat `(drawing_number, sheet_number)` as the stable identity tuple instead of parsing presentation `number` values. Enablement is managed internally by the Drawings development team. Please contact your Procore Account Manager or Support to request enablement. When not enabled, endpoints keep current behavior.

x-changelog.summary: Added Deleted Drawing Revisions Filter
x-changelog.description:
Deleted drawing revisions can now be queried via the drawing revisions REST API endpoint by including
`filters[deleted]=only` in request query parameters.

x-changelog.summary: Added sort parameter to list drawing revisions endpoint
x-changelog.description:
The list drawing revisions endpoint now accepts a `sort` parameter to dynamically sort results
by any table column (drawing_number, title, drawing_date, received_date, status, revision_number,
drawing_set, sheet_number, obsolete) and by custom fields using the `custom_field_<id>` key format.
Prefix the sort key with `-` for descending order. Unknown sort keys return HTTP 400.

x-changelog.summary: Relaxed invalid sort handling for drawing revisions list endpoint
x-changelog.description:
Invalid or unknown `sort` keys for the list drawing revisions endpoint no longer return HTTP 400.
The endpoint now falls back to the default sort order and returns HTTP 200, including unknown
standard keys and invalid custom field sort keys.

x-changelog.summary: Added drawing number to Android drawing revisions response
x-changelog.description:
The list drawing revisions endpoint now includes `drawing_number` in the `view=android`
response payload. This value falls back to `deleted_number` when the drawing has been deleted.

x-changelog.summary: Deprecated deletable field
x-changelog.description: The `deletable` field on drawing sets is now deprecated and will always return false. This is in preparation for a future update to the drawing sets API that will remove the field entirely. Clients should not rely on this field for any functionality, as it will not indicate whether a drawing set can be deleted or not.

x-changelog.summary: Added with_sketches and with_measurements filter params
x-changelog.description:
Two new optional query parameters for the List Drawing Sets endpoint:

`filters[with_sketches]=true` returns only sets that contain at least one drawing sketch.

`filters[with_measurements]=true` returns only sets that contain at least one measurement.

Both filters respect the `drawing_area_id` parameter when present, scoping results
to sketches/measurements on revisions within the specified drawing area.

x-changelog.summary: Added query parameter to specify view
x-changelog.description:
An optional query parameter to change the level of detail in the response.

`mfe` returns connected and deletable fields for the drawing set.

`legacy` is the default if not specified.

x-changelog.summary: Drawing sets are now returned in deterministic order
x-changelog.description:
The List Drawing Sets endpoint now returns sets ordered by position (ascending),
date (descending), and created_at (descending). Previously, no ordering was applied
and results were returned in non-deterministic database order.

Update handling preserves canonical drawing numbers by stripping an echoed `(<sheet_number>)` suffix from `number` inputs before persistence. Enablement is managed internally by the Drawings development team. Please contact your Procore Account Manager or Support to request enablement. When not enabled, endpoints keep current behavior aside from allowing a clear.

get.description:
Returns extracted text terms and locations for a collection of Drawing Revisions.

Drawing Revisions which do not have any recorded term data will be omitted from the response.
An empty term collection for a drawing indicates that the drawing has been processed, but that
no terms were found.

post.description:
Create a new Drawing Upload in the specified project.

It creates one `DrawingUpload`, which includes a `DrawingLogImport` and a `ProstoreFile`
for each file uploaded. Sidekiq then sends them to the image processing server.

First, it will try to process `files` parameter, if is empty, it will use `upload_uuids`.

files.description:
One or more files in PDF format to include in the upload.
*To upload drawings you must upload the entire payload as `multipart/form-data` content-type and specify each parameter as form-data together with `files[]` as files.
*Required only if upload_uuids is empty

upload_uuids.description:
Array of uploaded files UUIDs.
*Required only if files is empty

drawing_area_id.description:
Drawing Area ID
*Required only if Drawing Area is turned on
